0001-hicache-openssl-fallback.patch.reason: HiCache storage backends JIT-build hash_binding.cpp against OpenSSL, and the CUDA images ship no headers and no unversioned libcrypto.so, so the build fails and the server exits. Fall back to the interpreter prefix when the system headers are absent.

0002-ipc-tuple-get.patch.reason: The cuda_ipc JIT extension does not compile against tvm_ffi 0.1.9: Array's const iterator yields a const Tuple, and the free get<I> overloads fail to resolve on it. The build failure is non-fatal, so custom allreduce is silently disabled and every run falls back to NCCL. Take the element by value and use the member get<I>().
